exercises.name: Leg Press Horizontal
exercises.description: Push the platform away with both feet, while sitting in the horizontal leg press machine.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Squat down on the front leg, with the rear foot elevated on a bench, holding dumbbells.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Seated
exercises.description: Curl the pad down with both legs, while sitting in the seated leg curl machine.

exercises.name: Leg Extension Single Leg
exercises.description: Extend the pad upwards with one leg at a time, while sitting in the leg extension machine.

exercises.name: Calf Raise Machine
exercises.description: Raise the heels as high as possible, while loaded in the calf raise machine.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift Single Leg Dumbbell
exercises.description: Hinge at the hip on one leg, lowering the dumbbell towards the floor with a flat back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Pull the bar down to the upper chest, while sitting at the lat pulldown station.

exercises.name: Low Row Machine
exercises.description: Row the handles towards the torso, while sitting in the low row machine.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Pulldown
exercises.description: Pull the cable bar down to the thighs with straight arms, while standing.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Pull the rope towards the face, spreading the elbows wide, while standing at the cable station.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl Straight Bar
exercises.description: Curl the straight barbell up towards the chest, while standing with the elbows tucked in.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl Dumbbell
exercises.description: Curl the dumbbells up with a neutral grip, while standing with the elbows tucked in.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl Dumbbell
exercises.description: Curl a single dumbbell up, while sitting with the elbow braced against the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Super Horizontal Bench Press Machine
exercises.description: Press the handles forward, while sitting in the super horizontal bench press machine.

exercises.name: Incline Hammer Press
exercises.description: Press the handles upwards, while sitting in the plate loaded incline hammer press machine.

exercises.name: Overhead Press Dumbbell
exercises.description: Press the dumbbells overhead, while sitting on an upright bench.

exercises.name: Pec Fly Machine
exercises.description: Bring the handles together in front of the chest, while sitting in the pec fly machine.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.description: Bring the pads together in front of the chest, while sitting in the pec deck machine.

exercises.name: Tricep Bar Pushdown
exercises.description: Push the bar down until the arms are straight, while standing at the cable station.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Extend the arms overhead against the cable, while facing away from the stack.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height, while standing.
